Results.ReviewText: Absolutely perfect grill for 1-2 people on a daily basis. So easy to use. Cooks perfectly.  So glad i bought it
Results.Title: Perfect Grilling

Results.ReviewText: I like the portability of it, craftmanship and size.
Results.Title: Quality, compact grill

Results.ReviewText: I was searching for my first gas grill and I hit the jackpot with this one. Simple to put together and even easier to operate. Cooks food evenly. Love it!
Results.Title: Perfection

Results.ReviewText: Bought to travel around California with an RV, perfect size for a small group.
Results.Title: Very good heat for the size

Results.ReviewText: Don’t buy a Weber-Q! You’ll love it for a few months, but then you’ll have to buy a new regulator every 3-4 months. If you looking to buy, go to the parts section and search for a new regulator for a Weber-Q. You will see that the regulators on this product does not last. Many people having same issue. On my third regulator, I tried every step in the FAQ and resetting the bypass mode, but it didn’t work. I gave it a 5-star rating because most people don’t read the 1-star complaints.
Results.Title: DO NOT BUY!! Until you read this!!

Results.ReviewText: Cooks amazingly well, this is my second unit. My first lasted about 20+ years and was  great. I appreciate the folding side boards and temperature gauge on this model.
Results.Title: Great quality grill

Results.ReviewText: This was warranty work, have had the grill for a year and a half when the regulator broke. After a few back and forth emails with Weber they sent a new regulator with instructions to install it all under warranty. As for the grill, it works well for a small portable grill but is not very good for slow cooking. I would recommend this grill as long as you know of its limitations.
Results.Title: Warranty

Results.ReviewText: When I bought this grill I thought you could adjust the temperature. But your help line told me I couldn’t. Thought this was strange because there are three levels on the temperature control. I know I will not get an answer. But very disappointed. I will share this information with my friends
Results.Title: Bad

Results.ReviewText: great grill. replaced a weber 310.  does a good job
Results.Title: great small grill.

Results.ReviewText: I left a review a couple of months ago complaining that I had had to replace the regulator and it failed again when connected to a 20 lb tank. Weber reached out, and even though it was beyond warranty they sent me a new regulator and their connector hose (I had been using a Coleman one). So far it is working nicely. I appreciate their quick and generous response. Since I am not the only one with this problem, I would suggest that anyone planning to use a 20 lb tank with this grill use the proprietary Weber hose, and carefully follow the instructions on how to open the tank so as not to trigger the bypass function. As of now I am a happy customer ;)
Results.Title: I hope issues with 20 lb tank are now resolved

Results.ReviewText: Very good grill very fast and very good very good nice
Results.Title: Awesomeness  very professional

Results.ReviewText: My second on awesome grills. I just need the smaller one now so I can take it to work with me
Results.Title: Grilling RIBEYE ALL DAY EVERYDAY

Results.ReviewText: Great little camping grill. Can cook 4-5 large steaks on it perfectly.
Results.Title: Camping grill

Results.ReviewText: This is the second travel grill we have owned. And our newest purchase is awesome. Grills perfect, easy cleaning, take it with you... Easy peasy! Weber quality is superb. Don't purchase a knock off, get the best.
Results.Title: Excellent Product

ClientResponses.Response: Thank you for your feedback. So sorry to hear you had an issue with your valve and regulator assembly. Happy to hear this has been resolved. Our Care team will reach out to follow up. Thank you!

Results.ReviewText:
Grill worked fine initially but failed to light on our last trip. I called Weber and explained my dilemma,
They sent me a new regulator free of charge and I replaced it. It woks fine now so we’ll be back to cooking come camping season.
Results.Title: Regulator malfunction

Results.ReviewText: The lady i spoke to was totally AWESOME. Im sorry i forgot her name. But she was so helpfully and nice. What a credit to your company. I will always buy weber products
Results.Title: Recommend

ClientResponses.Response: Your feedback is very important to us. I'm sorry to hear about the unfortunate incident, and I hope everything is okay. Our Care Team will reach out to ensure this issue has been resolved. Please look for an outreach email from us soon. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Consumer Care

Results.ReviewText: The propane value failed and started a fire that melted the right side of the Bar-b-que.  Thankfully, I had a fire extinguisher and was able to put out the fire.  I contacted Weber support, and they send me replacement parts for the grill, and said it was my responsibility to disassemble it and replace the parts.  I hate put something like this is the trash, but I don’t know what else to do with it.
Results.Title: Dangerous product

Results.ReviewText: This little Weber Q is perfectly proportioned for one or two people. It has the "Goldilock effect." Not too heavy, not too light. not too big, not too small. So far I've cooked a pork tenderloin and steaks to perfection! I already had a great stand I wasn't using, so voila! perfection on the back patio. I can also take it on road trips due to its smallish size. Love it! Would buy again!
Results.Title: Best Little Q

Results.ReviewText: Works great! Just wish it had two separate burners
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText: We purchased this grill as a replacement grill for our friend in the Bahamas and were so pleased with the grill we decided to purchase ourselves one upon our return to the states. Great Grill.
Results.Title: Great little grill.

Results.ReviewText: This is my second 1200. Good winter grill to keep in the garage. Open the overhead door, roll your grill a few feet out to the driveway and grill your burgers or chicken. Put it back inside when you are done. Buy a stand for the grill on Amazon. Buy an adapter to use a 5, 10 or 20 pound tank. Lose the porcelain grates. They are useless. Buy some stainless wire grates from Stanbroil on Amazon (Weber should offer them as an option). This is a good backup grill.
Results.Title: Good grill with major modifications

Results.ReviewText: I’m pretty happy with my new Weber. However, it seems like the burner is faulty. Even on the low setting the temperature is 400 degrees and on high close to 600. There are slits on each side (front and back) that have a larger flame than the holes in the burner.
Results.Title: Faulty Burner?

Results.ReviewText: It is exactly what I needed and works perfectly!  The size is perfect and fits the small space that I chose for it. I can lift and move it easily should I need to bring it in out of the weather. We have hurricanes in my part of the world and I  am not big and strong so this is perfect for me.
Results.Title: Perfect

Results.ReviewText: This grill is portable and easy to use. It cooks very well and evenly. Lights up quickly and gets hot quickly so you can cook eight away. Would definitely purchase again if needed.
Results.Title: Excellent cooking

Results.ReviewText: Great innovation.  Compact, easy to use, portable.  Very efficient way to cook.
Results.Title: Great innovation

Results.ReviewText: Great size to tow in my Rv. I purchased a quick connect device to directly run from trailer propane system and the Weber cooked wonderfully. I was able to control the heat and my first camping trip using it turned out wonderful.
Results.Title: Weber for my RV

Results.ReviewText: After purchasing this grill, I started watching YouTube videos for cooking instructions and ideas and was able to replicate on a consistent basis. My confidence as a griller has now grown exponentially.
Results.Title: Consistent grilling results

Results.ReviewText: This is the best choice for my wife and myself, small compact, and works beautifully. This is the second one we had and would not buy any other brand.
Results.Title: Best barbecue unit to have.

Results.ReviewText: Great customer support. Troubleshooting and replacement part
Results.Title: World class support

Results.ReviewText: Great bbq. Heats up very quickly and cooks evenly. Service was exceptional good when I needed a new part.
Results.Title: Great BBQ and great service

Results.ReviewText: Great little grill, gets hot quick and does a good job cooking steaks.
Results.Title: Dynamite

Results.ReviewText: Needed a compact grill for our RV.  It's a good fit.  Only used once so far but works great.  Feels solid.  Will follow-up at a later day with more.
Results.Title: Compact, rigid, good design

Results.ReviewText: Easy to assemble out of the box. All parts were functional. The angle of the propane bottle connection was off so had to fight to get the bottle connected. But once hooked up it lit easily, heated up fast and grilled evenly. Also was easy to clean
Results.Title: Weber review

Results.ReviewText: This grill.has exceeded my expectations.  I never thought a portable grill could cook as well as the Q1200. I highly recommend getting one.
Results.Title: Best portable grill by far

Results.ReviewText:
The Q1200 is an impressive little grill. The heat seems to be consistent with no hot/cold spots.  The grill grates leave perfect grill marks on your food.

The only complaint is no stand and the cost of the stand is almost as much as the grill.
Results.Title: Q1200-cooks evenly

Results.ReviewText: Great portable grill. Heats up quickly and easy to clean. Bought a carry bag as well. Easy to store.
Results.Title: Tailgater

Results.ReviewText: My in-laws have been Weber fans for years.  I needed a new grill for camping, or using or RV and decided on Weber.  I noticed the quality during the brief assembly that was required.  I only used it twice but have been very satisfied.  My only criticism is using the propane supply directly from my RV.  I had to resort to the spin on disposable bottles because the supply line from the RV didn't provide enough pressure, or gas flow.  It works fine on other grills.
Results.Title: Very good quality.
